overview_description.description: Aleo provides a platform for building fully private applications using zero-knowledge technology. It offers a comprehensive toolkit that includes an application runtime environment, allowing software to compile, execute, and finalize its state autonomously. Aleo also supports a statically-typed programming language called Leo, designed specifically for private application development on the Aleo blockchain. The company engages its community through blogs and incentive programs to test the bounds of its decentralized technology.

about_short_description.short_description: Aleo offers a platform for building private applications using zero-knowledge technology and a specialized programming language called Leo.

product.name: Aleo Network
product.description: A zero-knowledge blockchain for building and running applications that can process transactions and data privately while allowing selective verification.

product.name: Leo
product.description: Aleo’s programming language for writing private applications and generating zero-knowledge proofs for execution on the Aleo Network.

product.name: snarkVM
product.description: A zero-knowledge virtual machine that executes Aleo programs and verifies or generates proofs for private blockchain computations.

product.name: snarkOS
product.description: An open-source Aleo blockchain node implementation used to operate network infrastructure, validate transactions, and participate in consensus.

product.name: Aleo SDK
product.description: A software development kit and related developer resources for integrating with the Aleo Network and building zero-knowledge applications.

product.name: Aleo Explorer
product.description: A blockchain explorer for inspecting public Aleo network activity, including blocks, transactions, and other verifiable network information.
